summary: SEC12 review found one queued wallet-session capture race in 3f88ebca; Miles is fixing it and testing the queue boundary. Backend cancellation/replay had no confirmed blocker. Existing focused tests and synthetic Chrome desktop/mobile QA passed, including precision, stale-notice and clipping fixes. Fresh review precedes Dorian build/publication. No deployment or customer financial action; SOL mint and XRP deployments remain confirmed, ICP reserve separate.
plainSummary: The recovery controls pass the initial tests, but independent review caught a wallet-session race while Continue waits behind another action. That is being fixed and tested before release. Existing SOL minting and XRP fixes remain verified; no loan or transfer has been submitted for the customer.
